name: warmUp
desc:
When true, ElasticsearchServiceProvider.boot issues a HEAD /
against the cluster at startup and logs a warning on failure.
Defaults to false — the client stays fully lazy.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: ElasticsearchServiceProvider
desc: Wires Elasticsearch into a Vania application.

name: IoElasticsearchTransport
desc: A default ElasticsearchTransport backed by dart:io's HttpClient.

name: Searchable
desc: Marks a Model as searchable via Elasticsearch.

name: collection
desc:
Alias for table. Some drivers (document stores) prefer the
"collection" spelling; both names route to the same underlying
state on every driver.

name: currentParamCounter
desc:
Returns the current parameter counter value.
Useful for synchronizing nested queries.

name: groupByRaw
desc: Emits expression into GROUP BY verbatim.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: hidden
desc: Columns stripped from the rows the model hands back.

name: noSuchMethod
desc: Invoked when a nonexistent method or property is accessed.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: orderByRaw
desc: Emits expression into ORDER BY verbatim.

name: registerRelations
desc:
Override this method to define model relationships
This method is called automatically when include() is used

name: resetCteState
desc:
Hook for QueryBuilder.resetQuery. Leaves the configuration and
escaping strategy alone — those describe the dialect, not the query.

name: resetQuery
desc:
Drops every clause accumulated so far, leaving the table, alias and
connection in place so the builder can be reused for a fresh query.

name: resetWindowState
desc:
Hook for QueryBuilder.resetQuery; the list is private to this
library, so the reset has to be driven from here.

name: runtimeType
desc: A representation of the runtime type of the object.

name: search
desc: Run a query against the model's index.

name: searchable
desc: Index this document into Elasticsearch.

name: searchableAs
desc:
The index the model lives in. Defaults to the model's table name.
Any ElasticsearchConfig.indexPrefix is applied automatically.

name: searchableId
desc: The document id — defaults to the primary key.

name: toSearchable
desc: The document body indexed for this model. Defaults to toJson.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: unsearchable
desc: Remove this document from the index.

name: bulkIndex
desc: Bulk-index a batch of searchable models.
